c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: The human picks the cycle flavor. Recommend shotgun because the direction is intentionally broad and the point is not yet settled. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Human selected shotgun. The itch spans supervision, knowledge representation, reasoning, and coding-first assumptions; knowledge representation and usage is central, while broader reasoning and less coding-first framing are the driving forces.

q1.title: The itch
q1.imperative: Ask one question: what is actually bugging the human enough to open this exploration now? Recommend a provisional answer grounded in issues #296 and #297, then let the human correct it. Record the answer as the finding.
q1.finding: The itch is cumulative: supervision, graph coherence, ontological structure, and external awareness all matter. The center is representing knowledge so it can actually be used; the motivating expansion is better reasoning and a system that is not conceptually limited to coding.

x1.title: Excursion decision
x1.imperative: After the point questions, decide with the human whether cycle 1 needs a research, prototype, or design-it-twice excursion. Record a brief before any dispatch; otherwise skip with reason.

status_detail.reason: Cycle point-questions expanded after the itch was resolved; excursion decision is deferred until those questions complete and will be appended as a fresh item.

q2.title: For whom
q2.imperative: Ask one question: who most needs this broader knowledge-and-reasoning system, and who decides it is working? Recommend Fred as the primary operator and agents as the immediate consumers, while explicitly testing whether the ambition includes other humans or teams. Record the answer as the finding.
q2.finding: The framework is for Fred's own experimentation, not a product or team platform. It exists to enable ideas: code is the first executable medium but not the boundary. Philosophy is an adjacent proving ground because representing concepts, arguments, and their logical relationships is itself part of the desired capability.

q3.title: What done feels like
q3.imperative: Ask one question: in a concrete session with this framework, what can Fred do with an idea that he cannot reliably do now? Recommend that the framework should let a loosely stated idea accumulate structure, expose contradictions and consequences, connect to prior thinking, and become executable or revisable without losing provenance. Record the answer as the finding.
q3.finding: A successful session lets a raw thought become connected to prior thinking, exposes assumptions, contradictions, implications, and alternatives, and leaves a sharper belief, valuable question, or executable artifact. The durable graph is shared cognitive infrastructure for Fred and collaborating agents, not a private visualization. This is a conceptual extension of the existing architecture graph; code remains attachable graph content rather than a discarded special case.

q4.title: Generalization boundary
q4.imperative: Ask one question: what must the generalized graph represent that the current architecture graph cannot represent without distortion? Recommend that code/structure stops being the mandatory spine and becomes one attachable artifact region, while concepts, questions, claims, arguments, evidence, and implications may have their own legitimate anchors. Record the answer as the finding.
q4.finding: Concepts, questions, claims, arguments, evidence, and implications are useful first-class nodes without code anchors. The wider graph is functionally unstructured and should not require a universal spine. A spine arose naturally for code because building and architecture need hierarchy, coverage, and completion; other bounded subnetworks, such as writing a book, may independently earn their own structure and rigor.

q5.title: Subnetwork boundary and local rigor
q5.imperative: Ask one question: how does a locally structured subnetwork acquire a boundary so that its schema, invariants, and completion rules can be evaluated? Recommend an explicit reusable frame declared for a purpose (software system, book, inquiry, journal), with overlapping membership allowed and no global ownership hierarchy. Record the answer as the finding.
q5.finding: Structured subnetworks are deliberately declared as named frames. Nodes may also naturally appear related through the wider network, but explicit relationships remain valuable and legible. Frame membership is non-exclusive: the same node may participate in multiple frames, potentially under different named relationships. Inferred clusters may supplement declared frames but do not replace them.

q6.title: Kill condition
q6.imperative: Ask one question: what fact would make the generalized knowledge network not worth building? Recommend the kill condition that explicit representation fails to improve either Fred's thinking or agent collaboration enough to repay capture and maintenance cost—for example, ordinary notes plus retrieval perform just as well. Record the answer as the finding.
q6.finding: There is no utility-based kill condition. Experimentation, learning, and enjoyment are themselves sufficient value; the framework need not outperform ordinary notes or justify itself as a product. It ends only by Fred's deliberate choice to shelve or redirect it.

x2.title: Research excursion: journal-system convergence
x2.imperative: Inspect Fred's journal-system work to answer one question: what representation, interaction, and reasoning patterns already exist there that should inform the generalized knowledge network? The excursion brief must be recorded on IDEAS_BOARD.md before dispatch. Search local sibling projects and Fred's GitHub repositories for the journal system, inspect primary repository artifacts, and return cited findings plus clear tested/NOT-tested scope. Run recover_crews.py before dispatch and again before consolidation.
x2.finding: Journal-system convergence is grounded in the corrected fredbuilds/journal-system repository. It is history-first and append-only, with immutable human inputs, additive provenance-carrying agent derivations, specialized local frames (daily notes, themes, intention ledger, values, project observations), human ratification for self-knowledge, and an external deterministic proactive spine. This strongly suggests a shared kernel of events/artifacts, typed relationships, epistemic status, overlapping frames, and frame-local protocols; architecture and journal become domain frames rather than separate systems. Full report: evidence/journal-research-result.md.

consolidation.summary: The project is a personal, agent-shared idea-enabling knowledge network: globally unstructured, locally rigorous through deliberately declared overlapping frames. Constellation and Journal System already act as compatible domain frames, exposing append-only history versus current projections and epistemic authority as the next load-bearing questions.
